description: This file is a header (.h) file declaring exported API functions for a Web Servlet object related to the BWSP (Broadway Web Service Plane) implementation. It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the Web Servlet object, without actual function implementations.

methods.name: BwspCreateWebServlet
methods.description: Factory function to create a Web Servlet object with specified context handles.

methods.name: BwspWsoCreate
methods.description: Function to instantiate a Web Servlet Object with context handles.

methods.name: BwspWsoRemove
methods.description: Function to remove and clean up a Web Servlet Object.

methods.name: BwspWsoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Function to enroll necessary objects into the Web Servlet Object.

methods.name: BwspWsoInitialize
methods.description: Function to initialize the Web Servlet Object.
